name: Raag Yaman (Kalyani)
arohana: N. R2 G3 M2 D2 N3 S'
avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M2 G3 R2 S
description: One of the most foundational and sublime evening ragas, defined by Teevra Madhyama (M2) and starting from Mandra Nishada (N.).

name: Raag Bhairav (Mayamalavagowla)
arohana: S R1 G3 M1 P D1 N3 S'
avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M1 G3 R1 S
description: The primordial morning raga representing Lord Shiva as Bhairava. Characterized by deep oscillations on Komal Rishabha (R1) and Komal Dhaivata (D1).

name: Raag Bhoopali (Mohanam)
prahar: First Prahar of Night (7 PM - 10 PM)
arohana: S R2 G3 P D2 S'
avarohana: S' D2 P G3 R2 S
description: A pure 5-note pentatonic scale omitting Ma and Ni completely. Celebrated across Bharat for its uplifting, crystal-clear serenity.

name: Raag Malkauns (Hindolam)
arohana: S G2 M1 D1 N2 S'
avarohana: S' N2 D1 M1 G2 S
description: An ancient midnight raga completely omitting Rishabha and Panchama. Possesses immense acoustic weight and hypnotic philosophical gravity.

name: Raag Bageshri
jati: Audav - Shadav (5 Notes Ascent, 6 Notes Descent)
rasa: Shringara and Viraha (Longing and Deep Beauty)
arohana: S G2 M1 D2 N2 S'
avarohana: S' N2 D2 M1 G2 R2 S
description: Depicts the tender emotion of awaiting the beloved in the quiet hours of night. Panchama (P) is omitted in Arohana and subtle in Avarohana.

name: Raag Darbari Kanada
arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D1 N2 S'
avarohana: S' D1 N2 P M1 P G2 M1 R2 S
description: Created by Miyan Tansen for the Mughal court of Akbar. Famous for its slow, dignified and heavy Andolans (slow oscillations) on Komal Ga and Komal Dha.

name: Raag Desh
jati: Audav - Sampoorna (5 Notes Ascent, 7 Notes Descent)
prahar: Second Prahar of Night (Rainy Season / 9 PM - 12 AM)
rasa: Desh Prem and Shringara (Patriotism and Joy)
arohana: S R2 M1 P N3 S'
avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
description: The musical foundation of Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay's Vande Mataram. Uses Shuddha Ni in ascent and Komal Ni in descent.

name: Raag Bhairavi
arohana: S R1 G2 M1 P D1 N2 S'
avarohana: S' N2 D1 P M1 G2 R1 S
description: Known as the Queen of Ragas. All four swaras Re, Ga, Dha, and Ni are Komal (flat). Traditionally performed as the grand finale of classical concerts.

name: Raag Hamsadhwani
arohana: S R2 G3 P N3 S'
avarohana: S' N3 P G3 R2 S
description: Created by Carnatic composer Ramaswami Dikshitar and beloved across both traditions. Dedicated to Lord Ganesha to invoke auspicious blessings.

name: Raag Shivaranjani
arohana: S R2 G2 P D2 S'
avarohana: S' D2 P G2 R2 S
description: Identical to Bhoopali except with Komal Gandhara (G2), which instantly shifts the emotional spectrum from serenity to soul-stirring pathos.

name: Raag Amritavarshini
arohana: S G3 M2 P N3 S'
avarohana: S' N3 P M2 G3 S
description: Legend records that Muthuswami Dikshitar brought rain to drought-stricken Ettayapuram by singing Anandamritakarshini in this raga.

name: Raag Miyan ki Todi
arohana: S R1 G2 M2 P D1 N3 S'
avarohana: S' N3 D1 P M2 G2 R1 S
description: The signature creation of Tansen featuring Komal Re, Komal Ga, Teevra Ma, and Komal Dha with intense microtonal inflection.

name: Raag Kafi
arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 N2 S'
avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G2 R2 S
description: The folk heartbeat of Bharat, especially associated with Krishna Leela, Hori songs, and springtime festivities.

name: Raag Khamaj
jati: Shadav - Sampoorna (6 Notes Ascent, 7 Notes Descent)
arohana: S G3 M1 P D2 N3 S'
avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R2 S
description: Re is omitted in ascent; features Shuddha Ni going up and Komal Ni coming down. Widely utilized in delicate Thumri and Dadra compositions.

name: Raag Bihag
prahar: Second Prahar of Night (10 PM - 1 AM)
arohana: S G3 M1 P N3 S'
avarohana: S' N3 D2 P M2 G3 M1 G3 R2 S
description: Features both Shuddha Ma (M1) and Teevra Ma (M2) in subtle dialogue in descent, giving it an unmistakable sweet, luminous fragrance.

name: Raag Ahir Bhairav
arohana: S R1 G3 M1 P D2 N2 S'
avarohana: S' N2 D2 P M1 G3 R1 S
description: A sublime blend of Bhairav in Purvanga (S R1 G3 M1) and Kafi in Uttaranga (P D2 N2 S). Evokes the tranquil waking of temple bells at daybreak.

name: Raag Megh
arohana: S R2 M1 P N2 S'
avarohana: S' N2 P M1 R2 S
description: Omits Ga and Dha entirely. Emulates thunderous dark rainclouds rolling across the sky with deep vocal resonance.

description: Root Parent Melakarta Scale #1 in the Venkatamakhin 72-scale system.
